overview: HippoTune implements a hippocampal-inspired continual learning method that embeds iterative key-value retrieval loops (Latent Deliberation) within Transformer layers, enabling multi-round associative recall and integration of prior-task knowledge while achieving second-order preconditioning effects with minimal computational overhead.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Centralized YAML/JSON configuration system managing all hyperparameters including PEFT pool size, prompt length, temperature, deliberation steps (Tmax), blending factor, convergence threshold, layer indices, regularization weights, and backbone settings, with support for experiment configuration inheritance and dataset-specific overrides.

modules.name: Continual Learning Dataset Loading and Preprocessing
modules.description: Data loading pipeline for Seq-CIFAR100, Seq-ImageNet-R, and Seq-CUB200 benchmarks implementing ViT-compatible image transformations (resize, normalize with ImageNet stats), class-incremental task splitting into sequential subtasks, and custom Dataset/DataLoader with task-aware sampling for buffer-free continual learning.

modules.name: Frozen ViT Backbone Setup
modules.description: ViT-Base/16 backbone initialization with pretrained weight loading, selective layer freezing (blocks, patch_embed, cls_token, norm, pos_embed), class token extraction, and hook-based intermediate hidden state access for each Transformer layer to serve as retrieval queries.

modules.name: PEFT Unified Retrieval Pool Initialization
modules.description: Construction of the shared parameter-efficient module pool with learnable key matrix K (for retrieval routing) and value matrix V (prompt/adapter parameters), supporting initialization schemes (uniform) and configurable pool size, prompt length, per-batch or per-example prompt sharing.

modules.name: Soft Key-Value Retrieval with Sparsity
modules.description: Routing mechanism computing relevance scores via query-key dot product with temperature scaling, softmax normalization with optional top-k filtering for sparse retrieval, producing attention weights over the prompt pool to select and weight relevant task-specific modules.

modules.name: Latent Deliberation Iterative Loop
modules.description: Core hippocampal-inspired component implementing the EC-DG-CA3-CA1 circuit abstraction: iterative retrieval starting from layer hidden state as initial query, performing multiple rounds of soft key-value lookup, projecting retrieved signals back to update the query via linear transformation and blending factor, continuing until convergence threshold or maximum iteration count, simulating multi-round associative recall.

modules.name: Query Update and Feedback Mechanism
modules.description: Query refinement procedure implementing the CA3 recurrent association: linear projection of retrieved value vectors, blending with current query via controllable mixing coefficient, enabling progressive sharpening of memory access patterns across deliberation steps while maintaining stability.

modules.name: One-Shot Fusion Module
modules.description: CA1-inspired integration that concatenates all retrieved vectors from each deliberation step along the feature dimension, then combines the fused retrieval representation with the original layer hidden state before feeding into the ViT block, enabling multi-level memory completion without repeated backbone forward passes.

modules.name: Orthogonality Regularization
modules.description: Regularization loss enforcing orthogonality of the key matrix K across all layers to reduce memory interference between task-specific submodules, computed as the Frobenius norm difference between K^T K and the identity matrix, promoting disentangled and diverse key representations.

modules.name: Entropy Regularization
modules.description: Regularization loss controlling the entropy of retrieval weight distributions across deliberation steps, balancing retrieval sharpness and robustness by penalizing overly diffuse or overly peaked attention patterns, computed as negative entropy over the softmax retrieval weights.

modules.name: Combined Training Objective
modules.description: Unified loss function combining cross-entropy classification loss for downstream task performance, orthogonality regularization for key disentanglement, and entropy regularization for retrieval controllability, with configurable weighting coefficients balancing these objectives during end-to-end optimization.

modules.name: Truncated BPTT Training Loop
modules.description: Training workflow with truncated backpropagation through time, propagating gradients only through the final steps of the retrieval loop to align training and inference budgets, managing sequential task learning with per-task epochs, Adam optimizer with specified learning rate, and gradient clipping for stability.

modules.name: Continual Learning Evaluation Metrics
modules.description: Computation of Accuracy (per-task test accuracy), Average Accuracy Across All Tasks (AAA, mean accuracy over all seen tasks after final task), and Forgetting Measure (FM, maximum accuracy drop per task from its historical best), along with backward transfer analysis for stability-plasticity trade-off assessment.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Systematic component removal experiments including: disabling iterative retrieval (Tmax=1), removing orthogonality regularization, removing entropy regularization, using last-step-only fusion instead of one-shot concatenation, disabling early stopping, and combinations thereof, with automated comparison table generation.

modules.name: Hyperparameter Sensitivity Analysis
modules.description: Swept evaluation of key design choices: maximum deliberation steps (Tmax), retrieval temperature, prompt insertion depth (layer ranges), blending factor, convergence threshold, and top-k sparsity, generating accuracy curves across task sequences for each configuration to identify optimal trade-offs.

modules.name: Computational Efficiency and Cross-Backbone Validation
modules.description: GFLOPs calculation and comparison with baseline methods, training time and GPU memory profiling, cross-backbone validation with DINO and SAM pretrained features, online continual learning evaluation (single epoch), task-incremental learning setting experiments, and comprehensive result aggregation into publication-ready tables and visualizations.
